Definition: a knob or belaying-pin (from its swelling form)
BiblicalUsage: Fifty gold taches couple the tabernacle curtains together, and fifty of brass couple the tent — little knobs that make many curtains one dwelling. The word is the clasp itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God joins his dwelling with small clasps, and the unity of his house hangs on things most eyes never see.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
